fact: On 30 September 2026 six working groups handed the digital economy minister 22 challenges and 36 recommendations for the future national AI strategy; the ministry and UNDP are to draft it, validate it at a workshop and present it to the government before promulgation, so it is still a draft.
title: Gabon/IA : 22 défis et 36 recommandations pour bâtir la stratégie nationale
